schema:name: Hand-drawn Monopoly board with draft ideas for Model Cities game
schema:description: Marked up, hand-drawn draft gameboard for "Model Cities," based on Monopoly. Each space includes handwritten actions for players landing on that space--instructions for those playing as white above, and those playing as black below. "Model Cities" was an early iteration of the "Blacks & Whites" game. Circa 1968.
schema:publisher: UC Davis Library, Archives and Special Collections
